PB_SEQUENCE: injuries
Every warrior taken out of action rolls on the Serious Injuries chart: Heroes a D66, Henchmen a D6.
experience
Heroes and Henchmen groups gain experience for the battle, with the underdog bonus; then any advance rolls.
exploration
One D6 for each Hero not taken out of action, one more for a win; the total gives the shards found, doubles or better an unusual location.
wyrdstone
Sell wyrdstone once per sequence; the price is for the whole lot and depends on the size of the warband.
veterans
Roll 2D6: the experience of the veterans available for hire this round.
rare
A Hero not taken out of action may look for one rare item (2D6 against its rarity); what he finds goes into the stash.
dramatis
Look for a Dramatis Persona if you want to hire one.
recruits
Hire new recruits with their free dagger and buy common items, in any order and as often as you like.
equipment
Swap equipment between models as you wish, provided they may use it.
rating
Update the warband rating. You are ready to fight again.
